name: YBS
recent: YBS 近期主要是董事与大股东 Yong Chan Cheah 及 Cheah Jik Capital 在 11 月多次申报买卖公司股份，包括在闭门期内的交易。公司也在 11 月中更换公司秘书并更改注册地址。9 月则公告第 24 届常年股东大会结果更正，其中特别决议 1 未获通过。
notable: 董事经理兼首席执行官 Yong Chan Cheah 在 11 月多次申报增持公司股份（直接及间接权益）。
公司于 11 月 16 日更换公司秘书并更改注册地址。
第 24 届常年股东大会的 7 项普通决议获通过，特别决议 1 未获通过。
risks: 董事经理兼首席执行官 Yong Chan Cheah 在闭门期内仍有股份交易申报。
第 24 届常年股东大会的特别决议 1 未获股东通过。

recent_en: YBS has mainly seen director and substantial shareholder Yong Chan Cheah and Cheah Jik Capital report multiple share dealings in November, including trades during the closed period. The company also changed company secretaries and its registered address in mid-November. In September, it issued a correction to the outcome of its 24th AGM, where Special Resolution 1 was not carried.
notable_en: Managing Director and CEO Yong Chan Cheah reported multiple increases in shareholdings (direct and indirect) in November.
The company changed company secretaries and its registered address on 16 November.
Seven ordinary resolutions were passed at the 24th AGM, while Special Resolution 1 was not carried.
risks_en: Managing Director and CEO Yong Chan Cheah reported share dealings during the closed period.
Special Resolution 1 was not passed by shareholders at the 24th AGM.
